# victorops_escalation_policy (Resource)

Manages a team escalation policy, which sets who is on-call for a team. Rotation group slugs must be fetched from the VictorOps public API (GET rotations). Update and delete may fail if they involve a routing key, which this provider cannot update or delete.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "victorops_escalation_policy" "high_severity" {
  name    = "High Severity"
  team_id = victorops_team.platform.id

  step {
    timeout = 0
    entries = [
      {
        type = "rotationGroup"
        slug = "rtg-wvvhXshpvaRdn7jM"
      }
    ]
  }

  step {
    timeout = 10
    entries = [
      {
        type = "rotationGroup"
        slug = "rtg-hfy3fUytq7otMNbf"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the escalation policy.
- `step` (Block List, Min: 1) The escalation steps for this policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--step))
- `team_id` (String) The slug/ID of the team this policy belongs to.

### Optional

- `ignore_custom_paging_policies` (Boolean) Whether to ignore custom paging policies when this policy is triggered.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--step"></a>
### Nested Schema for `step`

Required:

- `entries` (List of Map of String) The entries (targets) for this escalation step.

Optional:

- `timeout` (Number) The timeout in minutes before escalating to the next step.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import victorops_escalation_policy.high_severity <team_id>/<policy_id>
```
